a.xlink:title: Makes the widgets, empty until a loaded document is set.
A combo box that expands across its row and fits its size hint to its entries.
Gives the incident an end, or none (0 seconds) when checked is false.
Shows the fields of the selected incident again. While a run uses the scene they show it disabled.
Gives the incident the reduced speed of the field, or none (0 km/h) when checked is false.
Takes the id from the field. An empty or used id is dropped and the field shows the old id again.
Takes the reduced speed in km/h from its field and marks that the incident has one.
Takes the start from its field, in whole seconds; text that is no number counts as 0.
Sets the terminate-at-destination request of a breakdown (see the scene schema).
A spin box whose wheel is guarded by FocusWheel, which also gives it the stepSize property.
Deletes the selected incident and says in the status line that Undo restores it.
Inserts a copy of the selected incident, with a new unique id, after it.
A panel without a document.
The pick button was checked (true) or unchecked (false).
False while no scene is loaded or a run uses it.
True when a scene is loaded.

The panel has changed the document. Emitted after SceneDocument::changed().
The selected incident, or null when none is selected or the scene cannot be edited.
Lists the choices of targets of the selected incident again.
The time in seconds over which the occurrences of a service are counted. The panel must have a docume...
An incident id that is free across all scenarios.
A message for the status line of the window, shown for timeoutMs milliseconds.
Ends picking, unless the window system hid the panel, as when the window is minimized.
Takes the text of a field that is being edited into the document, as if the user had left the field.
